7cba81e3110af5750665d7f7dbf58edd943a1808.summary: Promotional page for a Kaspersky GReAT webinar, published 2022-03-10, on recent cyberattacks targeting Ukraine. It lists the presenters and says the talk will cover attack types, destructive malware analysis and defence advice, followed by Q&A. It contains no findings of its own and reads as a marketing piece for a webinar channel, so it is not a threat report.
